Line Cook - Full Time
Harbour Table Bistro (fictional) has been serving fresh seasonal food downtown since 2009. We are a busy 80-seat restaurant and our kitchen team is like family.

What you'll be doing:
* Prep vegetables, sauces and proteins before service
* Work the grill and saute stations during dinner service
* Plate dishes to our standards, quickly and consistently
* Follow food safety rules and keep your station clean
* Help with closing: cleaning, labelling and rotating stock

What you need:
* 1 year of experience on a line in a restaurant kitchen
* FOODSAFE Level 1
* Good knife skills
* Able to stay calm and keep up during a rush
* Available evenings and weekends

We offer staff meals, tip share and extended health benefits after 3 months.
